name: concise
description: Detects verbose comments, oversized files, and padded PR/issue descriptions, plus optional em dash and AI writing pattern packs (pluggable, env-controlled), and nudges Codex to trim them before you see the bloated version.

interface.shortDescription: Catch verbose comments, oversized files, and padded PR bodies
interface.longDescription: PreToolUse hooks deny a write or gh call that is over the verbosity limits and tell the agent exactly what to trim, so the fix lands before you see the bloated version.
defaultPrompt: Trim the comments in this file to the limits in the concise rules.
